04/23.03.2023: Heard the parties.

The applicant, who is in custody since 29.11.2021, has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Tapkara P.S. Case No.24 of 2021 (POCSO Case No.05 of 2022) registered under Sections 376(2)(n) IPC and Section 4/6 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of Spl. Judge,
POCSO Court, Khunti.
The applicant is an accused of committing rape.
It has been submitted by the counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Innocence has been claimed and participation in the trial has been assured.
It has been submitted that there is manipulation in the age record and even as per the allegation, no coercion or inducement has been applied.
On the above facts, prayer for bail has been made.
On the other hand, learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail.
From the perusal of the impugned order, it appears that the victim has already been examined.
Considering the stage of the trial, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant (s) on bail, at this stage.
Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the applicant(s) stands rejected.
